class.name: OcgGraphic3dCamera
class.brief_description: Camera class provides object-oriented approach to setting up projection and orientation properties of 3D view.
class.description: ! Camera class provides object-oriented approach to setting up projection ! and orientation properties of 3D view.

method.name: default
method.description: Default constructor. Initializes camera with the following properties: Eye (0, 0, -2); Center (0, 0, 0); Up (0, 1, 0); Type (Orthographic); FOVy (45); Scale (1000); IsStereo(false); ZNear (0.001); ZFar (3000.0); Aspect(1); ZFocus(1.0); ZFocusType(Relative); IOD(0.05); IODType(Relative)

method.name: from_2
method.description: Copy constructor.

method.name: CopyMappingData
method.description: Initialize mapping related parameters from other camera handle.

method.name: CopyOrientationData
method.description: Initialize orientation related parameters from other camera handle.

method.name: Copy
method.description: Copy properties of another camera.

method.name: Direction
method.description: Get camera look direction.

method.name: SetDirectionFromEye
method.description: Sets camera look direction preserving the current Eye() position. WARNING! This method does NOT verify that the current Up() vector is orthogonal to the new Direction.

method.name: SetDirection
method.description: Sets camera look direction and computes the new Eye position relative to current Center. WARNING! This method does NOT verify that the current Up() vector is orthogonal to the new Direction.

method.name: Up
method.description: Get camera Up direction vector.

method.name: SetUp
method.description: Sets camera Up direction vector, orthogonal to camera direction. WARNING! This method does NOT verify that the new Up vector is orthogonal to the current Direction().

method.name: OrthogonalizeUp
method.description: Orthogonalize up direction vector.

method.name: OrthogonalizedUp
method.description: Return a copy of orthogonalized up direction vector.

method.name: SideRight
method.description: Right side direction.

method.name: Eye
method.description: Get camera Eye position.

method.name: MoveEyeTo
method.description: Sets camera Eye position. Unlike SetEye(), this method only changes Eye point and preserves camera direction.

method.name: SetEyeAndCenter
method.description: Sets camera Eye and Center positions.

method.name: SetEye
method.description: Sets camera Eye position. WARNING! For backward compatibility reasons, this method also changes view direction, so that the new direction is computed from new Eye position to old Center position.

method.name: Center
method.description: Get Center of the camera, e.g. the point where camera looks at. This point is computed as Eye() translated along Direction() at Distance().

method.name: SetCenter
method.description: Sets Center of the camera, e.g. the point where camera looks at. This methods changes camera direction, so that the new direction is computed from current Eye position to specified Center position.

method.name: Distance
method.description: Get distance of Eye from camera Center.

method.name: SetDistance
method.description: Set distance of Eye from camera Center.

method.name: Scale
method.description: Get camera scale.

method.name: SetScale
method.description: Sets camera scale. For orthographic projection the scale factor corresponds to parallel scale of view mapping (i.e. size of viewport). For perspective camera scale is converted to distance. The scale specifies equal size of the view projection in both dimensions assuming that the aspect is 1.0. The projection height and width are specified with the scale and correspondingly multiplied by the aspect.

method.name: AxialScale
method.description: Get camera axial scale.

method.name: SetAxialScale
method.description: Set camera axial scale.

method.name: IsOrthographic
method.description: Check that the camera projection is orthographic.

method.name: IsStereo
method.description: Check whether the camera projection is stereo. Please note that stereo rendering is now implemented with support of Quad buffering.

method.name: SetFOVy
method.description: Set Field Of View (FOV) in y axis for perspective projection. Field of View in x axis is automatically scaled from view aspect ratio.

method.name: FOVy
method.description: Get Field Of View (FOV) in y axis.

method.name: FOVx
method.description: Get Field Of View (FOV) in x axis.

method.name: FOV2d
method.description: Get Field Of View (FOV) restriction for 2D on-screen elements; 180 degrees by default. When 2D FOV is smaller than FOVy or FOVx, 2D elements defined within offset from view corner will be extended to fit into specified 2D FOV. This can be useful to make 2D elements sharply visible, like in case of HMD normally having extra large FOVy.

method.name: SetFOV2d
method.description: Set Field Of View (FOV) restriction for 2D on-screen elements.

method.name: FitMinMax
method.description: Adjust camera to fit in specified AABB.

method.name: ZFitAll_2
method.description: Estimate Z-min and Z-max planes of projection volume to match the displayed objects. The methods ensures that view volume will be close by depth range to the displayed objects. Fitting assumes that for orthogonal projection the view volume contains the displayed objects completely. For zoomed perspective view, the view volume is adjusted such that it contains the objects or their parts, located in front of the camera.

method.name: ZFitAll_1
method.description: Change Z-min and Z-max planes of projection volume to match the displayed objects.

method.name: SetZRange
method.description: Change the Near and Far Z-clipping plane positions. For orthographic projection, theZNear, theZFar can be negative or positive. For perspective projection, only positive values are allowed. Program error exception is raised if non-positive values are specified for perspective projection or theZNear >= theZFar.

method.name: ZNear
method.description: Get the Near Z-clipping plane position.

method.name: ZFar
method.description: Get the Far Z-clipping plane position.

method.name: IsZeroToOneDepth
method.description: Return TRUE if camera should calculate projection matrix for [0, 1] depth range or for [-1, 1] range. FALSE by default.

method.name: SetZeroToOneDepth
method.description: Set using [0, 1] depth range or [-1, 1] range.

method.name: SetAspect
method.description: Changes width / height display ratio.

method.name: Aspect
method.description: Get camera display ratio.

method.name: ZFocus
method.description: Get stereographic focus value.

method.name: IOD
method.description: Get Intraocular distance value.

method.name: Tile
method.description: Get current tile.

method.name: SetTile
method.description: Sets the Tile defining the drawing sub-area within View. Note that tile defining a region outside the view boundaries is also valid - use method Graphic3d_CameraTile::Cropped() to assign a cropped copy.

method.name: SetIdentityOrientation
method.description: Sets camera parameters to make current orientation matrix identity one.

method.name: Transform
method.description: Transform orientation components of the camera: Eye, Up and Center points.

method.name: ViewDimensions_1
method.description: Calculate view plane size at center (target) point and distance between ZFar and ZNear planes.

method.name: ViewDimensions_2
method.description: Calculate view plane size at center point with specified Z offset and distance between ZFar and ZNear planes.

method.name: NDC2dOffsetX
method.description: Return offset to the view corner in NDC space within dimension X for 2d on-screen elements, which is normally 0.5. Can be clamped when FOVx exceeds FOV2d.

method.name: NDC2dOffsetY
method.description: Return offset to the view corner in NDC space within dimension X for 2d on-screen elements, which is normally 0.5. Can be clamped when FOVy exceeds FOV2d.

method.name: Frustum
method.description: Calculate WCS frustum planes for the camera projection volume. Frustum is a convex volume determined by six planes directing inwards. The frustum planes are usually used as inputs for camera algorithms. Thus, if any changes to projection matrix calculation are necessary, the frustum planes calculation should be also touched.

method.name: Project
method.description: Project point from world coordinate space to normalized device coordinates (mapping).

method.name: UnProject
method.description: Unproject point from normalized device coordinates to world coordinate space.

method.name: ConvertView2Proj
method.description: Convert point from view coordinate space to projection coordinate space.

method.name: ConvertProj2View
method.description: Convert point from projection coordinate space to view coordinate space.

method.name: ConvertWorld2View
method.description: Convert point from world coordinate space to view coordinate space.

method.name: ConvertView2World
method.description: Convert point from view coordinate space to world coordinates.

method.name: WorldViewProjState
method.description: Returns projection modification state of the camera.

method.name: ProjectionState
method.description: Returns modification state of camera projection matrix

method.name: WorldViewState
method.description: Returns modification state of camera world view transformation matrix.

method.name: OrientationMatrix
method.description: Get orientation matrix.

method.name: OrientationMatrixF
method.description: Get orientation matrix of Standard_ShortReal precision.

method.name: ProjectionMatrix
method.description: Get monographic or middle point projection matrix used for monographic rendering and for point projection / unprojection.

method.name: ProjectionMatrixF
method.description: Get monographic or middle point projection matrix of Standard_ShortReal precision used for monographic rendering and for point projection / unprojection.

method.name: ProjectionStereoLeft
method.description: Returns stereographic matrix computed for left eye. Please note that this method is used for rendering for Projection_Stereo.

method.name: ProjectionStereoLeftF
method.description: Returns stereographic matrix of Standard_ShortReal precision computed for left eye. Please note that this method is used for rendering for Projection_Stereo.

method.name: ProjectionStereoRight
method.description: Returns stereographic matrix computed for right eye. Please note that this method is used for rendering for Projection_Stereo.

method.name: ProjectionStereoRightF
method.description: Returns stereographic matrix of Standard_ShortReal precision computed for right eye. Please note that this method is used for rendering for Projection_Stereo.

method.name: InvalidateProjection
method.description: Invalidate state of projection matrix. The matrix will be updated on request.

method.name: InvalidateOrientation
method.description: Invalidate orientation matrix. The matrix will be updated on request.

method.name: StereoProjection
method.description: Get stereo projection matrices.

method.name: StereoProjectionF
method.description: Get stereo projection matrices.

method.name: ResetCustomProjection
method.description: Unset all custom frustums and projection matrices.

method.name: IsCustomStereoFrustum
method.description: Return TRUE if custom stereo frustums are set.

method.name: IsCustomStereoProjection
method.description: Return TRUE if custom stereo projection matrices are set.

method.name: SetCustomStereoProjection
method.description: Set custom stereo projection matrices.

method.name: IsCustomMonoProjection
method.description: Return TRUE if custom projection matrix is set.

method.name: SetCustomMonoProjection
method.description: Set custom projection matrix.

method.name: DumpJson
method.description: Dumps the content of me into the stream

method.name: Interpolate
method.description: Linear interpolation tool for camera orientation and position. This tool interpolates camera parameters scale, eye, center, rotation (up and direction vectors) independently.
